climate: A dry climate, and what little rain there is falls mostly in summer. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A state with three wine regions: Sonoita, Willcox and Verde Valley. Most vineyards are in the southeast, south and east of Tucson. Arizona has had success with grape varieties native to Italy and the Rhône Valley of southern France.
